experiment_id: Strategy B-v2 — Auction/Mean-Reversion with a balanced-regime gate
baseline: B-v1 frozen in commit 444b9f6c11a5ba0cc4979b954b97682423cec0b0; never edit or overwrite B-v1 source or outputs.
hypothesis: The B-v1 upper/lower auction extremes can represent price discovery rather than reversion during strongly directional 24-hour paths. Restricting entries to low-efficiency (balanced) paths may reduce regime-mismatch losses.

single_change.name: balanced-regime filter
single_change.metric: 24-hour close-path efficiency ratio (ER) computed on M5 closes
single_change.formula: ER = abs(close[t] - close[t-288]) / sum(abs(close[k] - close[k-1]) for k=t-287..t)
single_change.classification: BALANCED when ER <= 0.30; TRENDING when ER > 0.30
single_change.decision_time: At the completed liquidity-sweep candle close, before pivot confirmation and entry; only BALANCED setups may continue.
single_change.zero_path_rule: If the denominator is zero, ER is zero and the regime is BALANCED.
single_change.lookahead: None; uses only completed closes through the sweep candle.

unchanged_from_b_v1: 24h rolling auction range and 15% premium/discount extremes
prior-hour liquidity sweep and rejection definition
three-bar pivot confirmation within six bars
stop = sweep extreme plus/minus max(0.1 x ATR(14), 0.5 pip)
target = midpoint of range frozen at sweep
one open position per pair and no portfolio allocation overlay

data_and_universe.source: Existing repository cTrader M5 OHLC files with 14d names
data_and_universe.pair_selection: All seven pairs retained regardless of B-v1 results; no post-hoc exclusions.

analysis_plan: Report B-v2 trades, wins/losses, win rate, PF, gross R, estimated cost R, net R, average net R/trade, max drawdown R, and per-pair results.
Compare directly with frozen B-v1 on the same dataset and cost assumptions.
Do not tune the 0.30 threshold, change stops/targets, or select pairs after seeing B-v2 results.
Treat this as exploratory same-window research, not out-of-sample validation or evidence of profitability.
